prompt:
Production SPRITE SHEET for MOBA lane minion. Transparent alpha, crisp painted realistic fantasy miniatures matching provided roster. EXACT regular grid SIX columns by FIVE rows, thirty full-body sprites, equal SQUARE cells, no text/borders/background/floor/contact shadow. Slightly wide landscape6:5 aspect. Same character identity/view/scale in ALL30 frames. Orthographic isometric 3/4 game view facing screen-right at35deg down. All sprites and weapon COMPLETELY INSIDE each cell with10% transparent padding, never touch adjacent sprite. Body60%cellheight, feet ground pivot50%x85%. Six frames per row, chronological animation. Row1 IDLE, gentle breathing/cloth (or stationary vehicle). Row2 RUN, genuine articulated stride/wheel cycle, six distinctly DIFFERENT poses. Row3 ATTACK: frame1 anticipate, frame2 windup, frame3 maximum windup, frame4 CONTACT/firing, frame5 followthrough, frame6 recover. Row4 HIT reaction reel/flinch then recover (NOT a cast and NOT death). Row5 DEATH stagger/collapse/broken wreck until last frame prone motionless. No massive glows, NO extra enemies, no duplicated static cutouts. Keep royal blue cloth so engine can recolor red opponents.
UNIT: Large brown furry summoned bear, glowing amber eyes, royal-blue metal collar, no armor and no sword. Idle breath and head motion. Run six sequential four-legged bear strides with alternating paws. Attack bear rises slightly and winds up forepaw, swipe CONTACT at fourth frame, retract. Hit flinch but not collapse. Death stagger then topple prone on side.
Reference role: identify ONLY corresponding unit in the provided five-row roster (rows melee/caster/siege/super/bear). Generate this ONE unit in all thirty cells.
